name: Externship Program
org: Central Contra Costa Sanitary District (Central San)
what_you_do: Learn about careers in water and wastewater in a short program with an in-person tour. You hear how to apply for summer and internship jobs. You can join online or in person.
who_can_apply: High school students, college students, teachers and recent graduates can join. Students under 18 need a signed permission slip from a parent or guardian to go on the in-person tour. Say in your application if you are under 18.
pay_detail: Unpaid. You pay for your own travel and meals.
duration: In 2026: four partial days over two weeks in February
deadline_text: The 2026 session was in February. The page says the next session will be announced in 2027. Join the mailing list to hear when.
how_to_apply: Join the mailing list with the form on the program page. You will get an email when the next session is announced.
notes: The program is free to join. In-person events are optional, because you can take part fully online. Central San works with Contra Costa Water District on the program. Central San is at 5019 Imhoff Place, Martinez.
